basic_details.job_title: BMC Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 17 MRI Assistant, Multipurpose Worker and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: BMC Cooper Hospital Recruitment 2026 is for 17 temporary contract posts: MRI Technician, MRI Assistant, Executive Assistant, Nurse and Multipurpose Worker. The posts are at the Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation's Hinduhridaysamrat Balasaheb Thackeray Medical College and Dr. Rustom Narsi Cooper Hospital, Juhu. Candidates must submit the completed application in person at the hospital's Establishment Department between 26 October 2026 and 3 November 2026, by 4.00 pm. The interview for all posts is on 5 November 2026 at 11.00 am.

important_dates.application submission period: 26.10.2026 to 03.11.2026, 11.00 am to 4.00 pm (excluding public holidays, Saturdays and Sundays)

age_limit.details: On 1 October 2026, the candidate must not be below 18 years or above 38 years of age. This limit applies to all five posts.

the hospital will obtain a character and antecedents certificate for the eligible candidate from the police station concerned.
important_instructions: Candidates must declare any conviction by a court in a case of moral turpitude or a criminal case, and any pending police inquiry or court case against them. A single spell of temporary service will be purely for a period not exceeding 40 days at a time. The Dean may end the service without prior notice if the work during the temporary period is not satisfactory. Because the appointment is on contract, appointees cannot go to any court. At appointment, the candidate signs an agreement on Rs. 500/- stamp paper. Appointees must mark biometric attendance every day according to their duty hours, or they will be treated as absent. Absence without permission will be counted as leave without pay (LWP). The appointment will be cancelled at once, without prior notice, if the appointee is found guilty of indiscipline. A selected candidate who wants to resign must give 1 month's advance notice. Appointees will have no claim to permanent service in the Municipal Corporation and will get none of the benefits of regular service. Appointees must work in three shifts in any department of the hospital where they are posted by the Head of Department. Giving false information, certificates or documents, or hiding any information, at any stage leads to cancellation of the candidature, or termination of the appointment without prior notice. The Dean may stop the selection process at any stage for administrative or other reasons.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Candidates must hand in the application in person . The notice says applications received by post or online will not be considered. Applications submitted earlier to this office or anywhere else will also not be considered. The Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation says it has not authorised any person or other organisation to sell or accept applications. The fee is charged under circular क्र.एचओ/26403/लेखा dated 01.04.2026. It is non-refundable and will not be returned under any circumstances. It is paid at the Cashier Department (Room No. 65), First Floor, D Wing, Dr. Rustom Narsi Cooper Hospital, from 26 October 2026 to 3 November 2026 during office hours (11.00 am to 3.00 pm). All Saturdays, Sundays and public holidays are excluded. An application without the receipt for the prescribed fee will not be accepted. Before applying, candidates must check for themselves that they meet the qualifications and conditions for the post and are eligible for a purely temporary contract appointment. content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: All 17 posts are filled on a purely temporary contract basis for a period of 3 years from the first appointment. Pay is a consolidated honorarium per month. Contract staff get no dearness allowance, house rent allowance or any other allowance on top of the consolidated honorarium. On 1 October 2026, the candidate must not be below 18 years or above 38 years of age. This limit applies to all five posts. A degree in the science stream (BPMT) from a recognised university. 2 years' experience of MRI work. Must have passed the Secondary School Certificate (SSC) examination, an equivalent examination or a higher examination with Marathi as a subject carrying a 100-mark paper, in line with the qualifications for the cadre. A degree in the science stream (BPMT) from a recognised university. Must have passed the SSC examination, an equivalent examination or a higher examination with Marathi as a subject carrying a 100-mark paper, in line with the qualifications for the cadre. A graduate in commerce, science, arts, law or an equivalent stream from a recognised university. Good knowledge of computer operating systems, word processing, spreadsheets, presentations, database software, email, the internet and similar tools. A certificate of passing the Government English and Marathi typing examinations at a minimum speed of 30 words per minute in each. Must have passed the SSC examination, an equivalent examination or a higher examination with Marathi as a subject carrying a 100-mark paper, in line with the qualifications for the cadre. Higher Secondary education of Maharashtra State completed in the science stream. Must hold General Nursing Midwifery and a diploma (must have passed the full-time course of 3 or 3½ years prescribed by the Maharashtra Nursing Council). Registration with the Maharashtra Nursing Council (महाराष्ट्र परिचर्या परिषद) is required. Knowledge of MS-CIT is required. Knowledge of Marathi and English is required. Must have passed 10th/SSC. Must have passed the Secondary School Certificate examination (Std. 10) with Marathi as a subject carrying a 100-mark paper, or an equivalent examination with Marathi (higher or lower level), as per the norms of the Maharashtra State Board of Secondary and Higher Secondary Education. Must be able to write, read and speak Marathi. For the discipline-specific eligibility of each post, refer to the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: The notice lists these documents for the paramedical and administrative cadres: The application form, completely filled in Educational certificates: the 10th and 12th marksheets and certificates, and the documents the post's qualification requires (degree, diploma, postgraduate degree, fellowship, MSCIT or typing certificate, etc.) A registration certificate from the relevant council, for example the Maharashtra Medical Council or Pharmacy Council, as the post's qualification requires Experience certificates Aadhaar card PAN card Address proof – Driving Licence, Electricity Bill, Voting ID or Ration Card Married women: a photocopy of the marriage registration certificate A photocopy of the fee receipt Self-attest all photocopies. Women candidates should submit the marriage registration certificate and the gazette notification for a change of name. If they do not have these, married women may apply in their pre-marriage name.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in BMC Cooper Hospital Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 17 vacancies: 4 for MRI Technician, 4 for MRI Assistant, 1 for Executive Assistant, 4 for Nurse and 4 for Multipurpose Worker.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for BMC Cooper Hospital Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Submit the application in person by 4.00 pm on 3 November 2026. The submission period starts on 26 October 2026 and excludes public holidays, Saturdays and Sundays.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the MRI Technician post?
faq.answer: You need a science-stream degree (BPMT) from a recognised university and 2 years' experience of MRI work. You must also have passed SSC, an equivalent examination or a higher examination with Marathi as a 100-mark subject.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: On 1 October 2026, a candidate must not be below 18 years or above 38 years of age.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for each post?
faq.answer: The consolidated honorarium per month is Rs. 20,000/- for MRI Technician, Rs. 16,000/- for MRI Assistant, Rs. 22,000/- for Executive Assistant, Rs. 30,000/- for Nurse and Rs. 18,000/- for Multipurpose Worker.

faq.question: Q6. Are DA, HRA or other allowances paid on top of the honorarium?
faq.answer: No. The notice says contract staff will get no dearness allowance, house rent allowance or any other allowance besides the consolidated honorarium.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application fee and where is it paid?
faq.answer: The fee is Rs. 1028/- (Rs. 870/- plus 18% GST of Rs. 158/-) and is non-refundable. Pay it at the Cashier Department (Room No. 65), First Floor, D Wing, Dr. Rustom Narsi Cooper Hospital, between 26 October and 3 November 2026.

faq.question: Q8. Can I send the application by post or online?
faq.answer: No. Applications by post or online will not be considered. Hand in the application in person at the Establishment Department, First Floor, D Wing, with the fee receipt and the documents.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected?
faq.answer: A merit list will be prepared from the prescribed educational qualification and the interview marks, and the selection list is drawn from it. The interview is on 5 November 2026 at 11.00 am at the hospital in Juhu.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The posts are purely temporary and on contract, for a period of 3 years from the first appointment. Appointees have no claim to permanent service in the Municipal Corporation or to regular service benefits.
